title: Letterbox arrival: candidate locked ending for the series
status: APPROVED as a plate. Creative approval and the composite still outstanding.
why_this_shot: Keith chose it on 2026-09-09 from five options as the replacement closing beat. It dramatises the flat mail packer, which 02_brand/STATE.md records as the entire reason for that pack format (letterbox postage, large letter, no missed deliveries). It carries the product without a person in frame, which makes it repeatable as a locked ending across every episode.

frames.S7-letterbox-landed.png: fbf10cac-c8be-49e2-9448-e04a633fad05: end frame, and the composite reference

how_the_frames_were_made: The landed frame was generated first and approved. The drop frame is an EDIT of it (empty the mat, put the box through the slot), not a sibling generation. A first attempt generated both from near-identical prompts and they came back with completely different camera positions, which would have driven a whipping move instead of a vertical drop. Editing inherits the camera; a shared prompt does not.

timing.final_settle: frames 46-55, box drops 8px into the coir

composite_window.box_face_px: 788 x 460 at centre (642, 1090) in the 1080x1920 master
composite_window.stability: Box centre and size are PIXEL-IDENTICAL across every sample from f55 to f121 (measured f55/65/75/85/95/105/115/121). Single corner-pin, no motion tracking needed.
composite_window.note: A motion spike at f91 is confined to the top band of frame: the letterbox flap settling. The box region is unaffected.

verification.box_blank: Final frame read at 2.25x with contrast stretched: clean bone card, no printing, no invented type, no postal marking. Lid seams visible and usable as corner-pin landmarks.
verification.no_text_in_frame: No house number, no brand mark, no lettering on door, mat or letterbox.
verification.camera: Locked. Verified by tracking the box bounding box, not by eye: an eyeball read of a 4-frame contact strip suggested drift and was wrong.
verification.slow_motion: Fall completes in roughly 1.4s. Slightly slower than real gravity but within usable range; the slide out of the slot is the slow part.

edit_notes: Trim the head: the first ~15 frames are a slow slide out of the slot. Starting nearer the tip point makes the drop land harder.
Storyboard §9.1 says cut any slow motion the model added. The fall is mildly slow; a 1.3-1.5x retime on frames 1-45 with the hold left alone would tighten it.
Composite the real Kit 2 pack onto the blank face here, never in the model: §3 and §9.4.
Sound, per §8's logic: the flap snap, then the box landing on coir, one contact. No music sting on the product.

pack_art_for_composite.why: The front elevation is square-on and verified line by line, so it corner-pins onto a flat-lying box with the least distortion.

open: Not cleared to ship. The four pre-flight items still block the film, and this shot changes nothing about them. Compliance note: it introduces a doormat and front door but no person, no premises identifier and no claim.
